material_dependency_test.basis: The IV.A.2 assessment supplies paired data or summarized regression output together with stated assumptions and bounded context. Correlation/regression evidence can therefore be evaluated without first completing the separate III.D.3 descriptive-statistics evaluation capability.

dispositions.rationale: Descriptive statistics can support regression analysis, but the bounded regression target supplies the evidence needed for its own interpretation. The relationship does not meet the contract threshold for a mandatory hard prerequisite.

material_dependency_test.basis: The IV.C.2 assessment directly supplies a bounded problem statement, observed symptoms, candidate causes, and partial discriminating evidence. Root-cause reasoning can therefore be performed without first executing the separate IV.C.1 current-state versus target-state gap-analysis capability.

dispositions.rationale: Gap analysis can help frame a real improvement problem, but the qualified root-cause target supplies the problem and evidence it requires. The hard prerequisite is rejected while instructional sequencing remains free to place the topics together.

Basic DoE terminology plausibly supplies the factor, level, response, and run concepts used when interpreting DoE graphs and plots. The V.A.2 target supplies a labeled graph and bounded context, so machine evidence does not establish whether V.A.1 must be separately completed first or can be embedded within visual interpretation instruction. The relationship therefore remains noncanonical.

The I.B.1 capability explicitly applies Lean value, flow, and waste concepts, while V.C.1 applies waste-elimination analysis. This is a plausible conceptual foundation, but the V.C.1 target also supplies observed process activities and asks for evidence-supported waste classification. Current evidence does not prove whether I.B.1 must be separately mastered first or can be integrated into V.C.1 instruction, so a hard cross-domain edge is not admitted.

material_dependency_test.basis: The V.C.2 assessment supplies bounded process timing data or summaries, process context, and explicit measurement limits. Locating cycle-time accumulation and identifying supported reduction opportunities does not require first executing the separate V.C.1 waste-classification capability.

dispositions.rationale: Waste elimination can contribute to cycle-time reduction, but the qualified timing-analysis target is independently executable from timing evidence. A mandatory V.C.1 prerequisite would encode a common improvement pathway rather than proven capability dependence.
